title: Export Markdown Extension
description: Settings for Markdown export to PDF, DOCX, and HTML

diagramDPI.title: Diagram DPI
diagramDPI.description: Resolution for Mermaid diagram images captured from the browser (dots per inch). Uses calibrated scaling matching jupyterlab_mmd_to_png_extension. Standard values: 150 (standard), 300 (high quality print).

svgDPI.title: SVG Conversion DPI
svgDPI.description: Resolution for server-side SVG to PNG conversion in DOCX and PDF exports (dots per inch). Applies to all SVG images embedded in markdown. Standard values: 150 (standard), 300 (high quality print).

mathDPI.title: Math DPI
mathDPI.description: Resolution for LaTeX math expression images in PDF exports (dots per inch). DOCX uses native OMML equations (no images). HTML uses KaTeX client-side rendering. Standard values: 150 (standard), 200 (default), 300 (high quality print).

showAlertLabels.title: Show Alert Labels
showAlertLabels.description: Show alert type labels (NOTE, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, CAUTION) in exported documents. When disabled, only the alert content is shown with colored styling.

htmlAutoBackground.title: HTML Auto Background
htmlAutoBackground.description: Automatically detect light/dark theme preference in HTML exports using CSS prefers-color-scheme media query. When enabled, the exported HTML adapts to the viewer's system theme. When disabled, uses the configured light background color.

htmlDarkBackground.title: HTML Dark Background
htmlDarkBackground.description: Background color for dark theme in HTML exports (hex format). Only used when Auto Background is enabled.

htmlLightBackground.title: HTML Light Background
htmlLightBackground.description: Background color for light theme in HTML exports (hex format). Used as the default background when Auto Background is disabled, or as the light theme color when enabled.
